title: Dunphy’s
html_source:
A pub. Now called Doyle’s.
https://www.rte.ie/brainstorm/2018/0607/968915-finding-the-most-authentic-joyce-pub-for-bloomsday/

Bloom later thinks this is prime real estate for a pub because it is on the road to and from Glasnevin Cemetery.

This must be true because even though Mr Cunningham recalls a horrifying story of a corpse falling out of a coffin in front of Dunphy’s, just the mention of the place makes the men want to have a drink there after the burial.

A bleak joke within the bleak joke is that Paddy Dignam died of complications from alcoholism, but his friends are going to “drink to his health.”
